description: Empiric therapy for neutropenic fever. Mapped from DKR neutropenic_fever.json; TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02. Defined as ANC <500, or ANC 1000 with expectation that ANC will drop below 500 within 48 hours.

neutropenic_fever.description: ANC <500, or ANC 1000 expected to drop below 500 within 48 hours

conditional_adjuncts.condition: Suspicion of PNA, SSTI, line infection; hemodynamic instability; history of MRSA or PCN/Ceph resistant pneumococci
Suspected gingivitis, neutropenic enterocolitis, or perirectal abscess

one_time_doses.dose_note: 5mg/kg (IBW) x 1 dose, or 2mg/kg (IBW) if HD or CrCl <20
one_time_doses.note: TODO: tobramycin is named in DKR but has no monograph in guidelines/drugs/

regimens.reasoning: Cefepime first-line for neutropenic fever (TUH 2025-04-02). DKR dosing variant Neutropenic fever/CNS infections: 2g IV q8h if CrCl >50 (infuse 30 min).
regimens.evidence: TUH-Inc. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy Recommendations ver 2025-04-02
regimens.note: Add vancomycin if suspicion of PNA, SSTI, line infection; hemodynamic instability; or history of MRSA or PCN/Ceph resistant pneumococci. Add metronidazole if suspected gingivitis, neutropenic enterocolitis, or perirectal abscess. One-time tobramycin 5mg/kg IBW (2mg/kg if HD or CrCl <20) if septic shock (TODO: tobramycin not in guidelines/drugs/).

regimens.reasoning: Cefepime listed for none and pcn_mild_rash in DKR
regimens.note: Same adjuncts as no_allergy pathway: vancomycin and/or metronidazole when indicated; one-time tobramycin if septic shock (TODO: tobramycin not in guidelines/drugs/).

regimens.reasoning: Aztreonam plus vancomycin for severe PCN allergy (anaphylaxis)
regimens.note: If history of ESBL E. coli or Klebsiella spp. in the last 12 months or septic shock: for severe IgE-mediated PCN reactions, benefit of using carbapenem should be weighed; for non-IgE mediated PCN reactions (SJS/DRESS), discuss with ID. Add metronidazole if suspected gingivitis, neutropenic enterocolitis, or perirectal abscess. One-time tobramycin if septic shock (TODO: tobramycin not in guidelines/drugs/).

de_escalation.criteria: Duration depends on the infectious source and ANC recovery.
de_escalation.note: Consider ID consult if no clinical improvement past the expected duration. Please consult infectious diseases if assistance needed.
